resources.string: This app captures the device playback mix when Android allows it. DRM or apps that disable capture may be silent in the buffer even if you hear them. Bluetooth vs speaker does not change that.\n\nAndroid will show a system dialog that mentions screen or casting. That is the only way the OS allows access to internal playback audio—this app does not record your screen to a video file and does not send it anywhere; it only decodes audio for the rolling buffer on your device.

Google only provides one permission for “internal” audio: the same MediaProjection token used for screen recording. The system’s wording will talk about screen or casting — that is not something we can change.

Sample Snatcher uses that token only with AudioRecord playback capture. We do not create a screen video, do not stream your display, and do not upload audio.

If you are not comfortable with that system dialog, you will not be able to use playback capture on stock Android; the alternative would be recording from the microphone (not implemented here).
Microphone permission is required for playback capture.
Notifications keep buffering running in the background.
Applies the next time you start buffering (60–90 seconds).
Waveform: pinch to zoom in, drag to pan along the buffer when zoomed. Selection sliders always use the full buffer.
